lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu8Te4S4 (reduced formula Eu2TeS) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral environments throughout: each Te and S center has four Eu neighbors, while each Eu center has four neighbors (two S and two Te), with neighbor distances of 3.1309 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Eu tetrahedra and between Te and S tetrahedra.
